svg.title: Choose a task from the side menu
svg.desc: Home starts or continues an invoice check. Document library finds saved files and opens their details on the same page. Earlier quotations are hidden from the list until Show earlier quotations is selected. Their reviews and history remain accessible. The library does not confirm values or start a comparison.

g.text: Choose where to work from the side menu.
Start or continue an invoice check.
1. Add the invoice and purchase order
The work stays on one workflow page.
Search files, suppliers or invoice/PO numbers.
Download its original or review history
Show earlier quotations includes older files.
Saved reviews and history are kept.
The library is optional. Reading a file does not confirm its values.
